# Etienne Bacher

> Personal website of Etienne Bacher: blog posts about R, research, and software.

## Pages

- [Gallery](https://etiennebacher.com/gallery/): Data visualization gallery
- [Etienne Bacher](https://etiennebacher.com/): Hi there! I'm Etienne Bacher.
- [Why you should move from Stata to R](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2019-12-01-why-moving/): Some reasons that explain why I prefer R to Stata.
- [First contact with the data on R](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2020-01-22-first-contact/): A blog post describing the first steps of data cleaning and analysis using R.
- [My favorite shortcuts in RStudio](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2020-04-06-my-favorite-shortcuts/): Did you know that RStudio contains a lot of shortcuts to write code faster? Here are my favorites.
- [My application for the Shiny Contest (2020)](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2020-04-08-my-shiny-app/): A presentation of the application I submitted to the Shiny Contest 2nd edition.
- [What to do when your code doesn't work?](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2020-05-22-code-doesnt-work/): This is the list of actions I make when I have an error in R.
- [Visualize data on Nobel laureates per country](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2020-10-18-nobel-laureates/): A post where I make animated graphs and maps to visualize the repartition of Nobel laureates per country.
- [Use GitHub actions with R Markdown and Distill](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2021-03-19-use-github-actions-with-r-markdown-and-distill/): How can you automatically render README, Distill website...
- [How to create a gallery in Distill](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2021-04-11-how-to-create-a-gallery-in-distill/): Use lightgallery.js to create a gallery for your plots or images.
- [Reproduce some maps about 3G and 4G access](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2021-12-23-reproduce-some-maps-about-3g-and-4g-access/): I try to reproduce some maps made by Dominic Royé.
- [Mapping French rivers network](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2021-12-27-mapping-french-rivers-network/): Once again inspired by Dominic Royé's maps, I decided to map rivers in France. The dataset I use comes from HydroSHEDS. The code below is quite similar to the code in my previous post so I don't spend a lot of time on it.
- [Some notes about improving base R code](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2022-11-28-some-notes-about-improving-base-r-code/): A small collection of tips to make base R code faster.
- [Where should my family meet?](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2023-01-14-where-should-my-family-meet/): Or a mathematical way to evade the debate on the location of the next holidays.
- [Do bonus points lead to more tries in 6 Nations matches?](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2023-03-01-do-bonus-points-lead-to-more-tries-in-6-nations-matches/): A small post where rugby is an excuse to do some webscraping and some ggplot-ing.
- [Making POST requests with R](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2023-05-09-making-post-requests-with-r/): An alternative to RSelenium to get data from dynamic webpages.
- [Using property-based testing in R](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2024-10-01-using-property-testing-in-r/): When you don't want to write dozens of versions of unit tests.
- [Refactoring code with flir](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2025-05-23-refactoring-code-with-flir/): How to efficiently rewrite many code patterns.
- [Jarl: just another R linter](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2025-11-20-introducing-jarl/): Remove bad patterns in your R code in the blink of an eye.
- [Jarl 0.4.0](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2026-02-03-jarl-0.4.0/): Find unreachable code, ignore diagnostics, show summary statistics of diagnostics, and more.
- [Jarl 0.5.0](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2026-03-23-jarl-0.5.0/): I'm glad to announce the release of Jarl 0.5.0. Jarl is a very fast R linter, written in Rust. It finds inefficient, hard-to-read, and suspicious patterns of R code across dozens of files and thousands of lines of code in milliseconds. Install or update Jarl via the command line…
- [Jarl 0.6.0](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2026-08-24-jarl-0.6.0/): I'm glad to announce the release of Jarl 0.6.0. Jarl is a very fast R linter, written in Rust. It finds inefficient, hard-to-read, and suspicious patterns of R code across dozens of files and thousands of lines of code in milliseconds. Install or update Jarl via the command line…
- [Snapshotting error messages](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/2026-09-15-snapshot-errors/): A snapshot is a file that contains the output of a function as it would appear to the user. For instance, you could save snapshots to capture the output of plot() so that you can check that it looks correct, and so that you know if this output changes even by just a few pixels in…
- [Blog](https://etiennebacher.com/posts/)
- [Research](https://etiennebacher.com/research/): Nature, 652
- [Software](https://etiennebacher.com/software/): a tutorial on webscraping static pages with rvest.
